name: Fried Egg Breakfast Tostadas with Tomato, Avocado & Hot Sauce
instructions: Arrange tortillas on a large baking sheet pan. Drizzle with oil on both sides, then season with salt.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until tortillas are golden and crispy, 5-7 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, gently crack eggs into the skillet and cook until the tops of the whites are set but the yolks are still runny, about 4 minutes. Remove from heat and season with spices.
While the eggs are cooking, wash, dry, and small dice tomatoes.
Wash, dry, halve, and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and slice crosswise into thin half-moons.
To serve, divide crispy tortillas between plates; top with eggs, tomatoes, and avocado. Drizzle with hot sauce and enjoy!
author: Mealime
